definition: Relating to the belt of constellations followed by the sun.
book: Twenty Thousand Leagues under the Sea
author: Jules Verne
quote: My remembrances went to France in the train of those zodiacal stars that would shine in some hours’ time.
example_sentence: On dark nights you can see the faint zodiacal light.
